correctness.rationale: For every r>=1 squarefreeness and genus follow from gcd(5,2*3^r)=1. Explicit Cartier coefficients at 2,2g+2,4g+2 reduce to partial multiplication-by-5 on odd residues mod 4g. Since 5 generates (Z/3^q)^× and fixes mod4, all lower-half cycles are exactly three labels. This proves stable rank 3; verifier reconstructs matrix and cycles for r=1..6.
